sentences.text: Terrence Dashon Howard -LRB- born March 11 , 1969 -RRB- is an American actor and singer .

Having his first major roles in the 1995 films Dead Presidents and Mr. Holland 's Opus , Howard broke into the mainstream with a succession of television and cinema roles between 2004 and 2006 .	Dead Presidents	Dead Presidents
He was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Actor for his role in Hustle & Flow .	Academy Award for Best Actor	Academy Award for Best Actor	Hustle & Flow	Hustle & Flow

Howard has had prominent roles in many other movies including Winnie , Ray , Lackawanna Blues , Crash , Four Brothers , Get Rich or Die Tryin ' , Idlewild , August Rush , The Brave One and Prisoners .	Winnie	Winnie (film)	Ray	Ray (film)	Lackawanna Blues	Lackawanna Blues	Crash	Crash (2004 film)	Four Brothers	Four Brothers (film)	Idlewild	Idlewild (film)	August Rush	August Rush	The Brave One	The Brave One (2007 film)	Prisoners	Prisoners (2013 film)
Howard played James Rhodes in Iron Man and reprised the role in the video game adaptation .	James Rhodes	War Machine	Iron Man	Iron Man (2008 film)
However , he was replaced by Don Cheadle for the future films .	Don Cheadle	Don Cheadle
He currently stars as the lead character Lucious Lyon in the television series Empire .	Lucious Lyon	Lucious Lyon	Empire	Empire (2015 TV series)
His debut album , Shine Through It , was released in September 2008 .	Shine Through It	Shine Through It
